intro: Deepfury's Orders is a crumpled parchment recovered from the body of Ol' Rustlocke beneath the Thandol Span. It contains grim instructions belonging to the Dark Iron dwarves who ambushed the scouting dwarven defender.

p: While scouting the foundations of the Thandol Span, the dwarven bridge defender Ol' Rustlocke was cornered and slain in a sudden Dark Iron ambush. Clasped beside the scout's clenched fist lay these orders, drafted by the enemy leader, Deepfury. The document serves as direct proof of a coordinated plot targeting the bridge that connects the Wetlands to the Arathi Highlands.
